description: The USDA plant hardiness zone for a US ZIP code from the 2023 USDA Plant Hardiness Zone Map (for example 6a), the average annual coldest winter temperature range it stands for in F and C, and the ZIP's coordinates. Answers "what growing zone am I in".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code, for example "80202" or "05401".

name: hardiness_zone
title: USDA plant hardiness zone by ZIP code
